# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in **lean-cloud-app-template**!

This repository is maintained as a **public GitHub template repository** and currently accepts **Issues only** (bug reports and feature/architecture proposals via the provided Issue templates).

- **Pull Requests:** External pull requests are not accepted at this time.
- **Building your own project:** Click **Use this template** on GitHub to create your own repository and customize freely under the [MIT License](../LICENSE).
- **Security & Privacy:** Never include real API keys, OAuth secrets, service account keys, `.tfstate` files, or private GCP project IDs in Issues.
